title: Europe Caves to Trump on Tariffs

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空的七个十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60个超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用一个不同的起始词。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝175周年，帮助您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅即可在 nytimes.com slash subscribe 获取优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗，《纽约时报》出品。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: By almost all accounts, the historic trade deal that was just reached between the United States and the 27 nations of the European Union is far better for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有说法都表明，美国与欧盟27国刚刚达成的那项历史性贸易协议，对美国而言要好得多

sentences.en: than it is for Europe.
sentences.zh: 远胜于对欧洲而言。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Brussels Bureau Chief Gina Smiling, on why the EU caved to President Trump and the blowback that it's causing.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事、布鲁塞尔分社社长吉娜·斯迈林将剖析欧盟为何向特朗普总统屈服以及由此引发的强烈反弹。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, July 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月29日，星期二。

sentences.en: Gina, always a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 吉娜，很高兴能邀请到你。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: You know, it occurs to me that, Gina, when two sides reach any kind of major deal, they usually find a way to tout it, to celebrate it, even if they don't exactly like it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我突然想到，吉娜，当双方达成任何重大协议时，他们通常都会想方设法去宣扬、去庆祝，哪怕他们并不那么喜欢它。

sentences.en: And that's not exactly what's happening on the European side of this enormous trade deal that was just reached between Europe and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而这并不是欧洲方面对于欧洲和美国刚刚达成的这项庞大贸易协议的真实反应。

sentences.en: No, that is very much not what is happening on the European side of this trade deal.
sentences.zh: 不，欧洲方面对这项贸易协议的反应完全不是这样的。

sentences.en: I think the most optimistic takes we're hearing are things like, well, gee, this could have been worse.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们听到最乐观的看法也就是诸如“唉，这本可以更糟糕”之类的话。

sentences.en: Not exactly a ringing endorsement.
sentences.zh: 这可算不上什么热烈支持。

sentences.en: No, no, not at all.
sentences.zh: 不，不，一点也不。

sentences.en: This is a humiliating capitulation on behalf of the EU.
sentences.zh: 这是欧盟的一次奇耻大辱。

sentences.en: And it really calls into question this amazing negotiating strength that the EU was supposed to exert.
sentences.zh: 这确实让人对欧盟本应展现出的惊人谈判实力打了个大大的问号。

sentences.en: And the most pessimistic things we're hearing are this was a political capitulation.
sentences.zh: 而我们听到的最悲观的看法则是，这是一次政治投降。

sentences.en: This is a shame for Europe.
sentences.zh: 这是欧洲的耻辱。

sentences.en: It's not a win for anybody.
sentences.zh: 这对任何人来说都不是胜利。

sentences.en: It's a miserable deal.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔糟糕透顶的交易。

sentences.en: I'm appalled.
sentences.zh: 我震惊了。

sentences.en: I'm absolutely appalled.
sentences.zh: 我简直震惊得无以复加。

sentences.en: And one quote was, it's a dark day when an alliance of free peoples gathered to affirm their values and defend their interests, resolves to submit.
sentences.zh: 其中一条引言是：“当一个为捍卫自身价值观和利益而聚集的自由人民同盟决定屈服时，这是一个黑暗的日子。”

sentences.en: And that one was from the French prime minister.
sentences.zh: 这话出自法国总理之口。

sentences.en: So very negative reviews.
sentences.zh: 所以评价非常负面。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: One of the leaders of France just basically accused all of Europe of submission to President Trump.
sentences.zh: 法国的一位领导人基本上指责整个欧洲向特朗普总统屈服了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it wasn't just the French complaining about this.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是法国人在抱怨此事。

sentences.en: We saw it coming from the Belgians.
sentences.zh: 我们看到比利时人也在抱怨。

sentences.en: We saw it coming from analysts.
sentences.zh: 我们看到分析人士在抱怨。

sentences.en: We saw it coming sort of across the board.
sentences.zh: 我们看到各方基本上都在抱怨。

sentences.en: There were a lot of complaints about this deal.
sentences.zh: 关于这项协议有太多的抱怨声。

sentences.en: It really makes you wonder, what is it actually doing for its member states?
sentences.zh: 这真的让人不禁想问，它究竟为成员国做了什么？

sentences.en: It's a real failure on the part of the European Commission in negotiating here.
sentences.zh: 这是欧盟委员会在谈判中的一次彻底失败。

sentences.en: And just explain what's behind these dramatic, somewhat abashed, embarrassed, even ashamed reactions from some of these European officials.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下这些欧洲官员表现出的戏剧性、略带局促、尴尬甚至羞愧的反应背后的原因。

sentences.en: why this does appear to them to be so bad for the European Union.
sentences.zh: 为什么这在他们看来对欧盟如此糟糕。

sentences.en: I think it's really a matter of this deal looking a lot worse in the details than what had been expected for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我认为这其实是因为这项协议的细节比长期以来的预期要糟糕得多。

sentences.en: Europe is, depending on how you measure it, either the world's second or third largest economy with a huge trading relationship with the United States.
sentences.zh: 无论你如何衡量，欧洲都是世界第二或第三大经济体，与美国有着巨大的贸易往来。

sentences.en: And for a long time, European Union officials thought that that would give them some amount of leverage when negotiating with the Trump administration
sentences.zh: 长期以来，欧盟官员认为这会在与特朗普政府谈判时赋予他们一定的筹码

sentences.en: And what they discovered is actually they ended up having a much more difficult time than they had expected,
sentences.zh: 而他们发现，实际情况是他们的处境比预期要困难得多，

sentences.en: and they had to accept a worse deal than I think that they had thought they would, even as recently as a month or a few weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 而且他们不得不接受一项比他们甚至在一个月或几周前想象的还要糟糕的协议。

sentences.en: And just take us on a very quick spin through the important numbers that reflect the worst-than-the-expectedness of this.
sentences.zh: 请带我们快速浏览一下那些反映出局势比预期更糟的重要数字。

sentences.en: Yeah, the big number is 15 percent, which is the across-the-board tariff rate that the Trump administration has agreed to here,
sentences.zh: 是的，最大的数字是15%，这是特朗普政府在此同意的全面关税税率，

sentences.en: which would apply to about 70 percent of all European Union goods being sent to the United States.
sentences.zh: 这将适用于运往美国的约70%的欧盟商品。

sentences.en: And that is up from what?
sentences.zh: 这比以前提高了多少？

sentences.en: That is up from the low single digits, depending on how you measure it, coming into this year.
sentences.zh: 这比今年刚开始时处于个位数低端的水平有所上升，具体取决于你如何衡量。

sentences.en: And it is pretty dramatically higher than what Europe had expected that they were going to arrive at.
sentences.zh: 而且它比欧洲原本预期达到的水平高得多。

sentences.en: So at first, Europe was hoping that they could negotiate Trump back down to those low single digits.
sentences.zh: 所以起初，欧洲希望他们能通过谈判让特朗普把关税降回那些个位数低端的水平。

sentences.en: And then even up until a few weeks ago, they were hoping that they could get him to 10 percent.
sentences.zh: 甚至直到几周前，他们还希望能够让他把关税定在10%。

sentences.en: They were hoping that 10 percent would be the prevailing tariff rate.
sentences.zh: 他们曾希望10%会是普遍的关税税率。

sentences.en: And so 15 percent is not a particularly good outcome.
sentences.zh: 因此，15%并不是一个特别好的结果。

sentences.en: But just to ask the obvious question, why has Europe agreed, submitted, in the words of this French prime minister,
sentences.zh: 但问一个显而易见的问题，为什么欧洲会同意——用这位法国总理的话说就是屈服于——

sentences.en: to a trade agreement that almost none of them seem to really like?
sentences.zh: 一个几乎没有人真正喜欢的贸易协议？

sentences.en: I think there are two really big forces that argued for them to make a deal and for them to make this deal now.
sentences.zh: 我认为有两个非常强大的因素促使他们达成协议，并促使他们现在就达成协议。

sentences.en: The first is that they were increasingly worried that this could turn into a real tariff trade war spiral.
sentences.zh: 首先，他们越来越担心这可能会演变成一场真正的关税贸易战螺旋。

sentences.en: And I think that that was not initially on their radar in the way that it ultimately became on their radar.
sentences.zh: 我认为最初这并没有像最终那样进入他们的雷达范围。

sentences.en: Going into this, if you rewind to Liberation Day, April 2nd,
sentences.zh: 在进入这个阶段之前，如果你把时间倒回解放日，即4月2日，

sentences.en: that day when President Trump stood out in the Rose Garden with his poster saying what the across-the-board tariff rates were going to be on different economies.
sentences.zh: 那天特朗普总统站在玫瑰园里，拿着海报展示针对不同经济体的全面关税税率将是多少。

sentences.en: Back then, European Union officials really thought that they could negotiate down their across-the-board tariff rate, which was 20% as of Liberation Day.
sentences.zh: 当时，欧盟官员真的以为他们可以通过谈判降低他们的全面关税税率，自解放日起该税率为20%。

sentences.en: Then those negotiations did not go well, and President Trump threatened to slap them with 50% tariffs, but he backed off of that relatively quickly.
sentences.zh: 后来那些谈判很不顺利，特朗普总统威胁要对他们征收50%的关税，但他很快就收回了这一威胁。

sentences.en: And so I think they thought that they could still negotiate down.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他们当时觉得他们仍然可以通过谈判降下来。

sentences.en: And then you get up until very recently when President Trump was threatening Europe with 30%.
sentences.zh: 然后直到最近，特朗普总统还在用30%的关税威胁欧洲。

sentences.en: And just as these threats kept rolling in and as he kept doubling down on them, it became more obvious to Europe that he was pretty serious about them.
sentences.zh: 正随着这些威胁不断涌现，以及他不断加码，欧洲越来越明显地看出他是认真的。

sentences.en: And a tariff rate around 30% would absolutely have crushed transatlantic trade.
sentences.zh: 大约30%的关税税率绝对会摧毁跨大西洋贸易。

sentences.en: European Union officials were really clear about that.
sentences.zh: 欧盟官员对此非常清楚。

sentences.en: And so I think they got increasingly worried that if they retaliated, they might just poke the bear.
sentences.zh: 因此我认为他们越来越担心，如果他们进行报复，可能只是在激怒这头熊。

sentences.en: President Trump might still double down.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统可能还会进一步加码。

sentences.en: It could just result in this spiraling situation where they're retaliating, the administration is reacting,
sentences.zh: 这可能会导致一种螺旋式的局面，他们采取报复，政府做出反应，

sentences.en: and that it would both cost jobs here in Europe and also potentially crush an economy that has been growing but not growing very quickly.
sentences.zh: 这既会毁掉欧洲的就业机会，也可能会摧毁一个一直在增长但增长并不算很快的经济体。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: So at some point in the kind of yo-yoing of Trump's position, which starts off very firm and then there's a pause and sometimes it feels like he's backing down,
sentences.zh: 所以在特朗普立场摇摆不定的某个时刻，一开始态度非常坚决，然后会有所停顿，有时感觉他是在退缩，

sentences.en: but then he's back up with an even higher threat.
sentences.zh: 但接着他又带着更高的威胁卷土重来。

sentences.en: At some point, European Union officials say to themselves, this is becoming real, even if it's very unpredictable.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，欧盟官员对自己说，这正在变成现实，尽管它非常难以预测。

sentences.en: And maybe because it's becoming so unpredictable, we now fear that the worst version of this is going to become our reality.
sentences.zh: 也许正因为它是如此不可预测，我们现在担心最糟糕的版本将成为我们的现实。

sentences.en: Yes, or a very extreme version of this.
sentences.zh: 是的，或者说是一个非常极端的版本。

sentences.en: I think there was this growing recognition that the Trump administration was really willing to inflict some serious pain to achieve their trade goals.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们越来越认识到，特朗普政府确实愿意带来一些严重的痛苦来实现其贸易目标。

sentences.en: I'm just curious what an example would be of the pain that they most feared.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇他们最害怕的痛苦会是一个什么例子。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I think the most specific and clear example might be the pharmaceutical sector.
sentences.zh: 好的，我想最具体、最清晰的例子可能就是制药行业。

sentences.en: And so pharmaceuticals typically not tariffed because these are really important, potentially life-saving medicines that consumers need.
sentences.zh: 制药业通常是不征收关税的，因为这些是消费者需要的、极其重要且可能救命的药物。

sentences.en: But President Trump has opened an investigation into the global pharmaceutical industry.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普总统已经对全球制药行业展开了调查。

sentences.en: He's been very clear that he wants to bring some of it back to the United States.
sentences.zh: 他非常明确地表示，他希望将部分产能带回美国。

sentences.en: And he has been threatening to put potentially really huge tariffs on this industry.
sentences.zh: 他一直威胁要对这个行业征收可能非常巨大的关税。

sentences.en: He's thrown out numbers like 200 percent.
sentences.zh: 他抛出了诸如200%这样的数字。

sentences.en: That would be a very big deal for Europe because pharmaceuticals and the chemicals related to them are the number one export that the EU sends to America.
sentences.zh: 这对欧洲来说将是一件大事，因为医药及相关化学品是欧盟对美国出口的头号产品。

sentences.en: And so this was a real point of concern.
sentences.zh: 因此，这确实是一个令人担忧的问题。

sentences.en: And I think it was one that became more and more salient because you were seeing the pharmaceutical companies really warning that if big tariffs hit,
sentences.zh: 我认为这个问题变得越来越突出，因为你看到制药公司真的在发出警告，如果高额关税来袭，

sentences.en: they might have to pick up and move operations to the United States.
sentences.zh: 他们可能不得不拔营起寨，将业务转移到美国。

sentences.en: You were seeing pharmaceutical companies trying to stockpile product in the United States to try and sort of mitigate disaster if this actually came to pass.
sentences.zh: 你看到制药公司试图在美国囤积产品，以图在这种情况真正发生时减轻灾难。

sentences.en: And so I think it just became, as the months wore on, more and more real that this might happen.
sentences.zh: 因此我认为，随着时间的推移，这种事情可能会发生的现实感越来越强烈。

sentences.en: And that was sort of an example of the kind of cautionary tale, the kind of, you know, reworking of economic relationships that really started to catch people's attention.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是那种引以为戒的故事、那种开始真正引起人们注意的经济关系重塑的一个例子。

sentences.en: We've already started to see a lot of pain in the automotive sector.
sentences.zh: 我们已经开始看到汽车行业感受到了巨大的痛苦。

sentences.en: So obviously, American consumers are probably very familiar with German car makers, you know, the BMWs, the Mercedes Benzes of the world.
sentences.zh: 显然，美国消费者可能对德国汽车制造商非常熟悉，比如宝马、梅赛德斯-奔驰之类。,

sentences.en: They were staring down pretty serious tariff rates.
sentences.zh: 他们当时正面临着相当严厉的关税税率。

sentences.en: and that if those had continued for a really long time could have been very damaging to their business.
sentences.zh: 如果这些关税长期持续下去，可能会对他们的业务造成极大破坏。

sentences.en: And so I think there was also a very, you know, intense push by the German carmakers and by carmakers in general to try and come to some kind of deal to make it a little bit less
sentences.zh: 因此我认为德国汽车制造商以及整个汽车行业的制造商也进行了非常强烈的推动，试图达成某种协议，使其不那么

sentences.en: punishing and certainly to increase the certainty around what tariffs were going to look like.
sentences.zh: 痛苦，并当然要增加关税走向的确定性。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You said that there was a second reason beyond fear of economic trauma from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你提到除了担心来自美国的经济创伤之外，还有第二个原因

sentences.en: towards
sentences.zh: 针对

sentences.en: European Union countries.
sentences.zh: 欧盟国家。

sentences.en: So what was that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么原因呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, and I think this one is actually the more surprising one.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这个原因其实更令人意外。

sentences.en: But there have been all of these other issues that have become sort of bundled up into this trade war that are typically thought of as pretty unrelated to trade.
sentences.zh: 但是还有所有这些其他问题也被卷入了这场贸易战中，而这些问题通常被认为与贸易截然无关。

sentences.en: So things like defense, things like America's involvement in
sentences.zh: 比如国防问题，比如美国对

sentences.en: NATO, things like America's support for the war in Ukraine, the other parts of the transatlantic relationship became very much tied up in this trade war.
sentences.zh: 北约的参与，比如美国对乌克兰战争的支持，跨大西洋关系的其余部分都在很大程度上与这场贸易战捆绑在了一起。

sentences.en: And the idea that if you ended up in a huge trade battle and if you ended up with really, really rapidly declining relationships
sentences.zh: 这种观点认为，如果你最终陷入了一场巨大的贸易战，如果你最终面对的是迅速恶化的关系

sentences.en: between the United States and the European Union, all of these really important geopolitical strategic priorities could get caught up in that mess.
sentences.zh: 在美国和欧盟之间，所有这些极其重要的地缘政治战略优先事项都可能被卷入这场乱局中。

sentences.en: In other words, EU trade officials began to feel like they couldn't disentangle doing a deal on tariffs with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，欧盟贸易官员开始觉得他们无法将与美国达成关税协议

sentences.en: from getting what they want from President Trump when it comes to arms for Ukraine or ongoing commitments to NATO.
sentences.zh: 与从特朗普总统那里获得他们在乌克兰武器或对北约的持续承诺方面想要的东西割裂开来。

sentences.en: And so they decide, let's do this deal because it will make everything else we're negotiating with the Trump administration easier.
sentences.zh: 因此他们决定，让我们达成这项协议，因为这会让我们与特朗普政府谈判的所有其他事情变得更容易。

sentences.en: Yeah, and they've been really explicit about that.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们对此表现得非常直白。

sentences.en: So, Mara Sefkovic, who is the European Union Trade Commissioner, told reporters on Monday explicitly that it's not only about trade, it's about security, it's about Ukraine,
sentences.zh: 因此，欧盟贸易专员马罗什·谢夫乔维奇周一明确对记者表示，这不仅关乎贸易，还关乎安全，关乎乌克兰，

sentences.en: it's about current geopolitical volatility.
sentences.zh: 关乎当前的地缘政治动荡。

sentences.en: So, you really kind of can't get more blunt than that.
sentences.zh: 所以，你真的找不到比这更直言不讳的表达了。

sentences.en: Like, he was saying that this deal is not just about trade anymore.
sentences.zh: 就像他在说，这项协议不仅仅关乎贸易。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And primarily what he seems to be saying and what you seem to be saying is this was about fear.
sentences.zh: 而他似乎主要在表达的，也是你似乎在表达的，就是这一切都源于恐惧。

sentences.en: And just to summarize what appears to have happened here, President Trump spooked the
sentences.zh: 为了总结这里似乎发生的事情，特朗普总统吓唬了

sentences.en: European Union, these 27 countries that collectively operate as one economic unit, on a variety of fronts, military, diplomatic, economic.
sentences.zh: 欧盟，这27个作为一个经济整体运作的国家，在军事、外交、经济等多个战线上都感受到了压力。

sentences.en: And this spooked EU decides to give the president more or less most of what he wants in the
sentences.zh: 而这个被吓坏的欧盟决定满足总统差不多大部分的要求，达成了他迄今为止

sentences.en: biggest trade deal that he has gotten so far, and that's how you get to a 15% tariff deal that most European leaders don't really like.
sentences.zh: 最大的贸易协议，这就是为什么会出现一个大多数欧洲领导人并不真正喜欢的15%关税协议。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这是对的。

sentences.en: I think even the fact that they emphasize so clearly that this was the biggest deal, that they kind of helped him to advertise
sentences.zh: 我认为，甚至他们如此明确地强调这是最大的协议，他们以一种非常特朗普式的语言

sentences.en: this in very Trumpian language, kind of speaks to the fact that they were really in sort of
sentences.zh: 来帮助他宣传这一点，恰恰说明了他们其实处于一种……

sentences.en: Okay, well, when we come back, we're going to talk about what this pretty lopsided deal means precisely on the ground for both sides.
sentences.zh: 好吧，当我们回来时，我们将讨论这个非常不平衡的协议对双方的实际地面情况意味着什么。

sentences.en: What Europe gave up and what the U.S.
sentences.zh: 欧洲放弃了什么，以及美国

sentences.en: seems to have gotten.
sentences.zh: 似乎得到了什么。

sentences.en: And we'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》游戏拼图之一“连连看（Connections）”的作者。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天都创作拼字游戏（Spelling Bee）和字母宝盒（Letterboxd）。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做字色联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时，我会看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 纽约时报的游戏是由人们制作的，就像你刚刚听到那些人的那样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 从今天开始游玩。

sentences.en: So Gina, let's talk about what exactly Europe gave up here.
sentences.zh: 吉娜，我们来谈谈欧洲在这里究竟放弃了什么。

sentences.en: Clearly, we've established that almost every industry is not going to be paying 15%.
sentences.zh: 很显然，我们已经确定几乎所有行业都不会去支付15%的关税。

sentences.en: So let's talk about what that is going to mean, its impact, and other things in this deal.
sentences.zh: 所以我们来谈谈这意味着什么、它的影响，以及这项协议中的其他内容。

sentences.en: stand out as being tough for Europe to swallow?
sentences.zh: 哪些内容对欧洲来说格外难以接受？

sentences.en: So I think the first most important thing to really sort of digest is what that 15% tariff that's going to apply to 70% of European goods will mean in practice.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为首先最重要、最需要仔细消化的一点是，将要适用于70%欧洲商品的15%关税在实践中意味着什么。

sentences.en: And what it will mean in practice is that products that are being sold into the American market are going to become a little bit less competitive vis-a-vis things that are
sentences.zh: 在实践中，这意味着销往美国市场的产品的竞争力将会略有下降，相比之下，

sentences.en: comparable and are produced by American producers.
sentences.zh: 那些同类产品是由美国本土生产商制造的。

sentences.en: And so I think a good example, assuming that it doesn't end up having an exemption applied to it in the next couple of days, could be a bottle of
sentences.zh: 因此我认为一个很好的例子——假设它在接下来几天内不会获得豁免权——可能就是一瓶

sentences.en: Italian Chianti.
sentences.zh: 意大利基安蒂红酒。

sentences.en: You're selling Chianti into the American market now.
sentences.zh: 你现在正将基安蒂红酒销往美国市场。

sentences.en: It's competing with some nice wines from California.
sentences.zh: 它正在与来自加利福尼亚的一些优质葡萄酒展开竞争。

sentences.en: And suddenly it is 15% more expensive, assuming the entire tariff is passed along to the consumer.
sentences.zh: 而突然之间，它的价格贵了15%，假设整个关税最终都转嫁给了消费者。

sentences.en: And so we're looking at a situation where European producers are going of a slightly tougher time selling into the US market.
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到的情况是，欧洲生产商向美国市场销售产品将变得稍微艰难一些。

sentences.en: That could also apply for things like cars.
sentences.zh: 这种情况也可能适用于汽车等产品。

sentences.en: Suddenly, depending on how things play out, your BMW or your Mercedes Benzes are going to be a little bit more expensive to get into America than they previously would have been.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，根据事态的发展，你的宝马或梅赛德斯-奔驰进入美国市场的成本会比以往更高。

sentences.en: Now, on the flip side, Europe is giving more favorable terms of trade to some American companies that are sending products here into Europe.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，欧洲正在向一些把产品运送到欧洲来的美国公司提供更优惠的贸易条件。

sentences.en: And so cars are another good example just to sort of follow along that line, they are now going to be subject to 0% tariffs coming into Europe.
sentences.zh: 因此汽车是顺着这个思路的另一个好例子，它们现在进入欧洲将享受0%的关税。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: American cars will be imported into Europe with zero tariffs, whereas European cars imported into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国汽车将以零关税进口到欧洲，而进口到美国的欧洲汽车

sentences.en: will be hit with 15% tariffs.
sentences.zh: 将遭到15%的关税打击。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so European cars are getting a little less competitive within the United States market
sentences.zh: 因此，欧洲汽车在美国市场上的竞争力有所下降，

sentences.en: at the same time that American cars are getting more competitive within the European market.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，美国汽车在欧洲市场上的竞争力却在增强。

sentences.en: I'm just trying to understand why Europe would agree to terms like that for cars.
sentences.zh: 我只是想弄明白，为什么欧洲会同意针对汽车的这种条款。

sentences.en: That would suggest that there has been a pretty serious existing imbalance, trade deficit,
sentences.zh: 这似乎表明，在汽车行业长期以来存在着相当严重的不平衡、贸易逆差，

sentences.en: within the car industry with way more European cars being brought into the American market than American cars being brought into the European market.
sentences.zh: 进入美国市场的欧洲汽车远多于进入欧洲市场的美国汽车。

sentences.en: Is that the case?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: It is the case that Americans buy more European cars than Europeans buy American cars.
sentences.zh: 确实是这样，美国人购买的欧洲汽车比欧洲人购买的美国汽车要多。

sentences.en: And it is also the case that prior to this year, there were slightly higher tariffs on American cars coming into Europe, especially if you count in trucks,
sentences.zh: 而且事实也是，在今年之前，进口到欧洲的美国汽车关税略高，特别是如果你把卡车也算在内的话，

sentences.en: than there were on European cars coming into America.
sentences.zh: 高于进口到美国的欧洲汽车关税。

sentences.en: So those things are true.
sentences.zh: 所以这些都是事实。

sentences.en: This reversal is bigger than an offset.
sentences.zh: 这种逆转的幅度超出了抵消的范畴。

sentences.en: And I think that the reason that this industry became such an important issue here is really that it's one that President Trump has been fixated on.
sentences.zh: 我认为这个行业之所以成为这里如此重要的问题，真正的原因是特朗普总统一直对此念念不忘。

sentences.en: He really cares about this.
sentences.zh: 他是真的很在乎这个。

sentences.en: A lot of times when he's in Europe, he'll remark on the fact that there are no American cars on European streets, you know.
sentences.zh: 很多次当他在欧洲时，他都会提到欧洲街头看不到美国汽车这一事实，你知道的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: He's not seeing Fords on the streets of Munich.
sentences.zh: 他在慕尼黑街头看不到福特汽车。

sentences.en: And so I think that that is part of the reason that this became sort of one of the sort of swap-a-roos, if you will, in this deal,
sentences.zh: 所以我想这就是为什么这成了协议中某种“乾坤大挪移”式内容的部分原因，如果你这么认为的话，

sentences.en: is that it was something that President Trump found very salient.
sentences.zh: 因为这是特朗普总统觉得非常显眼的一个问题。

sentences.en: Okay, so beyond giving a boost to American car manufacturing, how else does this deal benefit the American side of the ledger?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么除了提振美国汽车制造业之外，这项协议在账本的美国这一侧还有什么其他好处？

sentences.en: So we have heard from the Europeans that they are going to drop tariffs to very low rates or potentially even zero on a couple of products.
sentences.zh: 我们从欧洲人那里听说，他们将对一些产品把关税降至极低水平，甚至可能降至零。

sentences.en: We don't have the exhaustive list yet.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有拿到详尽的清单。

sentences.en: They haven't published it, but it's going to be potentially industrial goods, so things like machinery.
sentences.zh: 他们还没有公布，但可能涉及工业品，比如机械设备。

sentences.en: And then we're also hearing that it could be things like frozen seafood and lobsters.
sentences.zh: 然后我们还听说可能是冷冻海鲜和龙虾之类的东西。

sentences.en: Don't know who in the lobster lobby managed to pull that off.
sentences.zh: 不知道龙虾游说集团里是哪位神仙搞定了这件事。

sentences.en: But yeah.
sentences.zh: 不过确实如此。

sentences.en: What is more American than a Maine lobster, though?
sentences.zh: 不过，还有什么比缅因州龙虾更美国的呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, well, Maine lobsters coming to a Berlin bar near you.
sentences.zh: 对啊，嗯，缅因州龙虾即将登陆你附近的柏林酒吧。

sentences.en: Without a tariff.
sentences.zh: 免关税。

sentences.en: Without a tariff.
sentences.zh: 免关税。

sentences.en: And then we are also expecting some investments that the EU has reportedly pledged to make and that Trump made a really big deal out of when he was announcing the deal.
sentences.zh: 然后我们还期待欧盟据报已承诺进行的一些投资，这也是特朗普在宣布该协议时大加渲染的内容。

sentences.en: For one thing, there is going to be $750 billion in investments in energy over the next three years.
sentences.zh: 一方面，未来三年将在能源领域进行7500亿美元的投资。

sentences.en: That's real money, if it's real.
sentences.zh: 如果是真的，那可是真金白银。

sentences.en: Yeah, big headline numbers, big questions about exactly how that's going to play out.
sentences.zh: 是的，大标题数字很吸引人，但对于这笔投资究竟将如何落实，存在着巨大的疑问。

sentences.en: The European Union, as such, does not have the ability to just make those kinds of purchases.
sentences.zh: 欧盟作为一个整体，并不具备直接进行此类采购的能力。

sentences.en: That's something that would happen at the member state levels.
sentences.zh: 那是需要在各成员国层面发生的事情。

sentences.en: And the EU can't necessarily force their hands when it comes to making such purchases.
sentences.zh: 而且欧盟不一定能强迫成员国去进行此类采购。

sentences.en: And so some serious questions about how that part would work.
sentences.zh: 因此，关于这部分将如何运作存在一些严肃的疑问。

sentences.en: OK, so now that we understand the ways in which this deal clearly benefits the U.S.
sentences.zh: 好的，既然我们已经了解了这项协议如何明显地极大地利好美国，并极大地不利于欧洲，

sentences.en: considerably and disadvantages Europe considerably, I want to understand how it fits into President Trump's goals for the second term trade war.
sentences.zh: 我想了解它如何契合特朗普总统关于第二任期贸易战的目标。

sentences.en: And really, he's laid out two main objectives in each negotiation, to have a fairer trade relationship with whoever the trading partner is, Japan, China, EU,
sentences.zh: 实际上，他在每场谈判中都提出了两个主要目标，一是与贸易伙伴（无论是日本、中国还是欧盟）建立更公平的贸易关系，

sentences.en: and to encourage more American manufacturing through these trade deals.
sentences.zh: 二是通关这些贸易协议来鼓励更多的美国制造业。

sentences.en: On those two scores, how should we think about what the U.S.
sentences.zh: 就这两点而言，我们该如何看待美国

sentences.en: and the EU just agreed to?
sentences.zh: 和欧盟刚刚达成的协议？

sentences.en: Is it making trade fundamentally fairer than it had been between the United States and the 27 countries of the EU?
sentences.zh: 它是否从根本上让美国与欧盟27国之间的贸易比以前更公平了？

sentences.en: And is it likely to spur more manufacturing in the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 它是否有可能刺激美国国内更多的制造业？

sentences.en: So I'm going to leave the question of fairness aside, but it is definitely the case that for years,
sentences.zh: 所以我要把公平性的问题先放一边，但毫无疑问的是，多年来，

sentences.en: the European Union has sold more to American consumers than European consumers have bought from American producers.
sentences.zh: 欧盟向美国消费者销售的商品一直多于欧洲消费者从美国生产商那里购买的商品。

sentences.en: And I think all else equal, you would assume that this would slightly rebalance that.
sentences.zh: 我想在其他条件相同的情况下，你会认为这会在一定程度上重新平衡这一点。

sentences.en: I think it's also the case that American consumers spend a little more and European consumers spend a little less.
sentences.zh: 我想事实也确实是美国消费者消费略多，而欧洲消费者消费略少。

sentences.en: So I'm not going to pretend that this is just going to completely change that relationship overnight.
sentences.zh: 所以我不会假装这会一朝一夕彻底改变这种关系。

sentences.en: On the question of whether this brings manufacturing back to the United States, 15% is probably not a prohibitive tariff.
sentences.zh: 至于这能否把制造业带回美国，15%可能并不是一个具有禁绝作用的关税。

sentences.en: It's probably not going to be the thing that, you know, causes company X to decide tomorrow that it needs to up and move to Syracuse.
sentences.zh: 它大概不会成为那种让X公司明天突然决定搬迁到雪城的事情。

sentences.en: Syracuse.
sentences.zh: 雪城。

sentences.en: But I think that at the same time, if you're a company and you've just lived through this
sentences.zh: 但我觉得与此同时，如果你是一家公司，刚刚经历了

sentences.en: really uncertain tariff period, and you think there's a possibility that the Americans could
sentences.zh: 这个极具不确定性的关税时期，而且你认为美国人有可能

sentences.en: do this again, or that this uncertainty could last into the future, or that, you know, this is
sentences.zh: 会再次这样做，或者这种不确定性可能会持续到未来，或者你知道的，这

sentences.en: not the end of the story, maybe if you're thinking about expanding, you're a little bit more likely
sentences.zh: 并不是故事的结局，也许当你考虑扩张时，你会更有可能

sentences.en: to set up shop somewhere in the United States where you are shielded from some of those concerns.
sentences.zh: 在美国的某个地方设立工厂，从而免受其中一些担忧的影响。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But I think it's important to emphasize, and I think the European Union would emphasize,
sentences.zh: 但我觉得重要的是要强调，而且我认为欧盟也会强调，

sentences.en: that this comes at some cost to Americans, right?
sentences.zh: 这给美国人带来了一定的成本，对吧？

sentences.en: When we talk about tariffs, they are fundamentally a tax, and somebody's got to pay that tax.
sentences.zh: 当我们讨论关税时，它们本质上就是一种税，总得有人来付这笔税。

sentences.en: And what we know from historical tariff experience is that that tends to be the end consumer, which in this case is the American consumer.
sentences.zh: 而从历史关税经验中我们所知道的是，买单的往往是最终消费者，在这个案例中就是美国消费者。

sentences.en: Of course, what President Trump would say is, if he's doing this right, and the European maker of Ozempic, for example, decides that its next factory should be in Syracuse,
sentences.zh: 当然，特朗普总统会说，如果他做对了，比如Ozempic的欧洲制造商决定将其下一家工厂设在纽约州

sentences.en: New York or Atlanta, Georgia, then American manufacturing just gains some new jobs and the people buying that Ozempic are not going to be hit with that 50 percent tariff.
sentences.zh: 雪城或佐治亚州亚特兰大，那么美国制造业就会凭空增加一些新工作岗位，而购买Ozempic的人也不会受到那15%关税的冲击。

sentences.en: Yeah, you could theoretically think that might happen over time.
sentences.zh: 是的，从理论上你可以认为随着时间的推移这可能会发生。

sentences.en: But in the interim, you've got that 15 percent tariff on the Ozempic that's coming into the country from Europe.
sentences.zh: 但在过渡期间，你得对从欧洲进口到国内的Ozempic征收15%的关税。

sentences.en: And so I think that the point that this is not costless is still worth emphasizing.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，这项政策并非毫无代价这一点仍然值得强调。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So, Gina, looking ahead,
sentences.zh: 那么，吉娜，展望未来，

sentences.en: do we think that 15% tariffs are likely to be the template for the next few deals that the president wants to achieve with countries that haven't reached deals with the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 我们是否认为15%的关税可能会成为总统希望与尚未与美国达成协议的国家达成的接下来几项协议的模板？

sentences.en: I know that so far he has reached a deal with the U.K., a very close ally, for 10% tariffs.
sentences.zh: 我知道到目前为止，他已经与一个非常亲密的盟友英国达成了10%关税的协议。

sentences.en: That's another framework.
sentences.zh: 那是另一个框架。

sentences.en: It's not yet fully in force.
sentences.zh: 它尚未完全生效。

sentences.en: With Vietnam, it was a 20% tariff.
sentences.zh: 对于越南，关税是20%。

sentences.en: Japan was 15%.
sentences.zh: 日本是15%。

sentences.en: and now we have 15% with the EU.
sentences.zh: 现在我们与欧盟达成了15%。

sentences.en: Should we expect 15% or so to be the template for the rest of the deals with the rest of the world?
sentences.zh: 我们是否应该预期15%左右的税率会成为与世界其他地区达成其余协议的模板？

sentences.en: Yeah, so President Trump indicated on Monday in Scotland that something in the range of 15% to 20% could basically be the template, that we could see that applying pretty broadly.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以特朗普总统周一在苏格兰暗示，15%到20%左右的税率基本上可以作为模板，我们可以看到这种税率得到相当广泛的应用。

sentences.en: And so I think that's interesting because it is not as punishing as some of the worst rates that he had been threatening.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这很有趣，因为它不像他曾威胁过的那些最糟糕的税率那么具有惩罚性。

sentences.en: But it's also obviously going to be a big step up for many economies that were facing much lower tariffs than that.
sentences.zh: 但对于许多原本面临低得多关税的经济体来说，这显然也将是一个巨大的跃升。

sentences.en: And so we're going to have to wait and see how all of that plays out.
sentences.zh: 所以我们得拭目以待这一切将如何发展。

sentences.en: It's going to be difficult to predict, especially because all of these changes are taking place at the same time, which makes them a little bit harder to understand.
sentences.zh: 这将很难预测，尤其是因为所有这些变化都在同时发生，这使得它们更难被理解。

sentences.en: You have to think about how they interact with one another.
sentences.zh: 你必须考虑它们是如何相互作用的。

sentences.en: But I think that the upshot here is we would see a pretty significant change in the global trading system.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这里的核心结论是，我们将看到全球贸易体系发生相当显著的变化。

sentences.en: And that's where I think I want to end this conversation by assessing exactly where we are in Trump's second-term trade war.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我想通过评估我们在特朗普第二任期贸易战中所处的准确位置来结束这次对话。

sentences.en: And I think if we're being honest, it began on Liberation Day with a fair amount of snickering from foreign ministers, from domestic economists,
sentences.zh: 我想如果实话实说的话，它始于解放日，当时招致了来自外国部长、国内经济学家

sentences.en: from political observers who saw his tariff strategy this time as fickle and volatile.
sentences.zh: 以及政治观察人士的大量冷嘲热讽，他们认为他这次的关税策略反复无常、变化多端。

sentences.en: And there was a sense that the White House was perhaps a little out of its depth in this trade war.
sentences.zh: 并且有一种感觉，即白宫在这场贸易战中可能有点力不从心。

sentences.en: And yet, here come the deals, especially the EU deal.
sentences.zh: 然而，协议却接踵而至，特别是欧盟协议。

sentences.en: And it's a capitulation from the other side and what looks like a victory for President Trump and suggests that his strategy, which might have looked chaotic from the outside,
sentences.zh: 这是对方的妥协投降，看起来像是特朗普总统的胜利，并表明他的战略——从外部看起来可能很混乱——

sentences.en: has been quite effective.
sentences.zh: 实际上非常有效。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think, you know, having covered this closely for several months now, the strategy was chaotic.
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，我认为，鉴于我近几个月来一直在密切报道此事，其战略确实是混乱的。

sentences.en: But I think this idea that just because it was chaotic meant it wouldn't ultimately achieve what President Trump was trying to achieve, maybe was a misreading.
sentences.zh: 但那种认为“仅仅因为它混乱就意味着它最终无法实现特朗普总统试图达成的目标”的想法，可能是一种误读。

sentences.en: And so we're still in the process of finalizing these deals.
sentences.zh: 所以我们仍处于敲定这些协议的过程中。

sentences.en: They could still fall apart.
sentences.zh: 它们仍然可能会破裂。

sentences.en: But it does certainly seem to be the case that President Trump is getting many things that he had asked for.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普总统确实似乎正在实现他所要求的许多事情。

sentences.en: And we've really heard from officials, including Mara Sefcovic, the EU trade commissioner who I had mentioned earlier, this idea that April 2nd, that Liberation Day,
sentences.zh: 我们确实从官员那里听到了这种说法，包括我之前提到过的欧盟贸易专员马罗什·谢夫乔维奇，4月2日那个解放日

sentences.en: was sort of this turning point.
sentences.zh: 算是一个转折点。

sentences.en: You know, that we're not going back to the world as it was before April 2nd.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们再也回不到4月2日之前的世界了。

sentences.en: This is a new world and we need to adjust to it.
sentences.zh: 这是一个新世界，我们需要适应它。

sentences.en: And adjust to what Trump wants when it comes to trade.
sentences.zh: 并在贸易问题上适应特朗普想要的东西。

sentences.en: At least to some extent, yeah.
sentences.zh: 至少在某种程度上是这样，是的。

sentences.en: Well, Gina, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，吉娜，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们深表感激。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Monday, President Trump broke with the leader of Israel, Benjamin Netanyahu, by acknowledging the starvation in Gaza, a subject that until now, Trump has largely ignored.
sentences.zh: 周一，特朗普总统承认加沙存在饥荒，这与以色列领导人本杰明·内塔尼亚胡分道扬镳，这是一个特朗普迄今为止在很大程度上一直忽视的话题。

sentences.en: Prime Minister Netanyahu said there's no starvation in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡总理表示，加沙不存在饥荒。

sentences.en: Do you agree with that assessment?
sentences.zh: 你同意这种评估吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I mean, based on television, I would say not particularly because those children look very hungry.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，根据电视报道，我认为情况并非如此，因为那些孩子们看起来非常饥饿。

sentences.en: As he spoke, Trump stood next to British Prime Minister Keir Starmer, who said that the people of the United Kingdom were horrified by the scenes out of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 在发表讲话时，特朗普站在英国首相基尔·斯塔默身旁，后者表示英国人民对加沙发生的一幕幕感到惊恐。

sentences.en: It's an absolute catastrophe.
sentences.zh: 这是一场绝对的灾难。

sentences.en: Nobody wants to see that.
sentences.zh: 没有人愿意看到这一幕。

sentences.en: And I think people in Britain are revolted at seeing what they're seeing on their screens.
sentences.zh: 我想英国人民看到他们在屏幕上看到的东西时感到反感。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, two of Israel's best-known human rights groups said that Israel was committing genocide against the people of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，以色列两个最著名的直权组织表示，以色列正在对加沙人民实施种族灭绝。

sentences.en: It marked the first time that major groups inside of Israel have reached that conclusion.
sentences.zh: 这是以色列国内主要组织首次得出这一结论。

sentences.en: And a gunman with an assault rifle has killed multiple people, including a police officer, in a midtown Manhattan office building.
sentences.zh: 一名持突击步枪的枪手在曼哈顿中城的一栋办公大楼内杀害了多人，其中包括一名警察。

sentences.en: The shooting occurred at around 6.30 p.m.
sentences.zh: 这起枪击事件发生在大约下午6点30分，

sentences.en: inside a building that houses the National Football League and the financial firm Blackstone, whose workers built a barricade of couches to protect themselves from the shooter.
sentences.zh: 地点在一栋大楼内，该大楼里有国家橄榄球联盟和黑石金融集团的办公室，其员工用沙发筑起路障以保护自己免受枪手袭击。

sentences.en: As of Monday night, the shooter's motives and target remained unclear.
sentences.zh: 截至周一晚上，枪手的动机和目标仍然不明。
